NONE: › the act of killing someone who is very ill or very old so that they do not suffer any more

example: Although some people campaign for the right to euthanasia, it is still illegal in most countries.
儘管有些人發起運動爭取安樂死的權利，但在大多數國家中實施安樂死仍是違法行爲。

NONE: › to kill an animal because it is very old or sick or because there is no one to take care of it

example: Overcrowded shelters would not be able to euthanize unwanted animals.
擁擠不堪的動物救助站無法對被遺棄動物實施安樂死。
